manifesto.one: A product professional with a designer's taste and an engineer's conscience. Today I build AI products, and build with AI, from discovery to code.
manifesto.two: Work is my hobby. I keep telling myself I'll slow down and do something else, but then I fall for another project or problem and it pulls me back in. I see in product challenges the same competitive side as online games, which were once my obsession too, World of Warcraft most of all.
